translation: (Voiceover): Amulya DJ Songs.. O girl.. where are you hurrying off to, girl.. tell me your village and your name, girl; tell me your village and your name, girl.. give me the details, won't you, girl. Past some grove or other, or a mango grove, our home is at Kakarla Badu; past some grove or other, or a mango grove, our home is at Kakarla Badu. Amulya DJ Songs..
Pallavi (Chorus): Abba.. you're a lovely-looking, beautiful girl.. whose family are you from, girl? You're a lovely-looking, beautiful girl.. whose family are you from, girl?

Our village is Palleluru, sir, a lovely place, sir; up on the rise, the gleaming house is ours, sir. Our village is Palleluru, sir, a lovely place, sir; up on the rise, the gleaming house is ours, sir.
Verse 1: In which lane is your house, girl.. I'll come proudly to your village, girl. In which lane is your house, girl.. I'll come proudly to your village, girl.
Oohu.. past the swings and the gate of the old hall, ours is Kota Moripa, sir. Oohu.. past the swings and the gate of the old hall, ours is Kota Moripa, sir. Amulya DJ Songs..
Verse 2: Hey-hey.. stop your games, girl.. don't change your name with every word, girl. Stop your games, girl.. don't change your name with every word, girl.
Bangarayinala, Vaddepatte, Pelli Battagunda: ours is Mosampadu, sir. Bangarayinala, Vaddepatte, Pelli Battagunda: ours is Mosampadu, sir.
Verse 3: Girl.. stop joking and tell me, girl.. don't hide your name and your village, girl. Stop joking and tell me, girl.. don't hide your name and your village, girl.
Ururu, Palluru, Jennala, Konduru: in Lingalapeta, ours is Yeleru. Ururu, Palluru, Jennala, Konduru: in Lingalapeta, ours is Yeleru. Amulya DJ Songs..
Verse 4: Hey-hey.. you girl with your tall talk and swagger.. tell me your real name, I'm begging you, girl. You girl with your tall talk and swagger.. tell me your real name, I'm begging you, girl.
Peruru, Kalamata, famous Nalakonda: in between, Narayanapuram is ours, sir. Peruru, Kalamata, famous Nalakonda: in between, Narayanapuram is ours, sir.
Verse 5: O girl.. you can't walk the road, get on my bike, girl.. I'll drive you there safely, girl. You can't walk the road, get on my bike, girl.. I'll drive you there safely, girl.
Konda Tirumalagiri, Bandaramaram: just past them, close by, is Palakurthi, sir. Konda Tirumalagiri, Bandaramaram: just past them, close by, is Palakurthi, sir.
Verse 6: Hey-hey.. don't keep changing your story every time, girl.. however far it is, I'll come, girl. Don't keep changing your story every time, girl.. however far it is, I'll come, girl.
Kururu, Guduru, Kalagandla, Kommala: believe me, sir, that's the truth. Kururu, Guduru, Kalagandla, Kommala: believe me, sir, that's the truth. Amulya DJ Songs..

Verse 7: Hey.. if you say you'll come, I'll come right along too, girl.. when I come again, you must let me see you, girl. If you say you'll come, I'll come right along too, girl.. when I come again, you must let me see you, girl.

Your village this way, our village that way: it's the fate that God has written. Your village this way, our village that way: it's the fate that God has written. The fate that God has written.. the fate that God has written.. Amulya DJ Songs.. the fate that God has written..
summaryEn:
Aathranga Pothunnav Ye Ooru ("Where Are You Hurrying Off To?") is a flirtatious duet sung by Gajwel Venu and Janaki on the SUPERHIT Telangana Folk Songs album (2021). The version recorded here is a DJ remix, and the label's tag, "Amulya DJ Songs", breaks in between verses.

The song stages a roadside meeting. A young man stops a girl who is walking by in a hurry and keeps asking her name and her village. She never gives a straight answer. Each time she reels off a chain of village names, such as Nalakonda and Narayanapuram, Tirumalagiri and Palakurthi, or Kommala, and he complains that she is joking, hiding things and changing her story with every word. The verses follow a steady call-and-response pattern: his question to "pilla" (girl) is answered by her list, which she ends with the respectful "ayya" (sir). He offers her a ride on his bike and promises to come however far away she lives, and the song ends by calling their meeting "the fate that God has written". Some words in the recorded lyrics appear to have been transcribed by ear, so a few place names and phrases are uncertain, but the playful, teasing mood is clear throughout.
summaryTe:
ఆత్రంగా పోతున్నవ్ ఏ ఊరు అనేది గజ్వేల్ వేణు, జానకి కలిసి పాడిన సరదా యుగళగీతం. ఇది 2021 నాటి SUPERHIT Telangana Folk Songs ఆల్బమ్‌లోనిది. ఇక్కడ ఉన్నది డీజే రీమిక్స్ రూపం కాబట్టి చరణాల మధ్యలో "అమూల్య డిజె సాంగ్స్" అనే లేబుల్ పేరు వినిపిస్తూ ఉంటుంది.

పాట దారిలో జరిగే ఒక కలయికను చిత్రిస్తుంది. హడావుడిగా వెళ్తున్న ఒక అమ్మాయిని ఆపిన యువకుడు ఆమె పేరు, ఊరు చెప్పమని పదే పదే అడుగుతాడు. ఆమె మాత్రం సూటిగా జవాబు ఇవ్వదు; ప్రతిసారీ నలకొండ, నారాయణపురం, తిరుమలగిరి, పాలకుర్తి, కొమ్మాల వంటి ఊళ్ళ పేర్లను గొలుసులా చెప్పుకుపోతుంది. దాంతో అతను పరాచికాలు ఆపు, ఊరు పేరు దాచకు, మాట మాటకీ పేరు మార్చకు అని నిష్ఠూరంగా అంటాడు. "పిల్లా" అని అతను అడిగే ప్రశ్నకు "అయ్యా" అని ముగిసే ఆమె జవాబు — ఈ ప్రశ్నోత్తరాల పద్ధతి పాట అంతా క్రమంగా సాగుతుంది. నడవలేవు బండెక్కు, భద్రంగా తీసుకెళ్తా, దూరమెంతైనా వస్తా అని అతను మాట ఇస్తాడు; చివరికి వీరి కలయిక "దేవుడు రాసిన రాతల రాత" అంటూ పాట ముగుస్తుంది. రికార్డు చేసిన సాహిత్యంలో కొన్ని మాటలు విని రాసినట్టుగా ఉండటంతో కొన్ని ఊరి పేర్లు, పదాలు స్పష్టంగా లేవు, కానీ పాటలోని ఆటపట్టింపు, సరదా భావం మాత్రం స్పష్టంగానే తెలుస్తుంది.
